On the book held by Arithmetic is the name of the Greek mathematician Pythagoras, while on the worksheet are the primary mathematical functions: addition, subtraction, and multiplication. La Hyre produced at least two such series--including the \"Allegory of Grammar\" ( Walters 37.862) --as decoration for the homes of the wealthy.
